III. ALPHABETICAL INDEX --------------------               356

   Publications classified CONFIDENTIAL or SECRET are identified
by the symbols [C] or [S], respectively, precehihg the number. The
symbol [CM] denotes a publication classified CONFIDENTIAL-
MODIFIED HANDLING AUTHORIZED. The title of such a
publication, if unclassified, is followed by (U). Publications with
classified titles are not indexed in section III. The symbol [0] denotes
a publication which is FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY and must be
protected in accordance with AR 380-1.

   CONFIDENTIAL and SECRET publications are distributed only
to interested headquarters and to individuals on a need-to-know
basis. These publications must be safeguarded in accordance with
AR 380-5.

   Section III is an alphabetically arranged subject index to the
numerical lists in section I. To find the publications dealing with a
given subject, look first in section III under the subject, e. g., Engines,
Gasoline; then look for the name of the model in which you are
interested-Continental Models; next look for the model number-
R-975-C1. There will be found all publications listed in section I
pertaining to the Continental Model R-975-C1 gasoline engine.
Check the numbers in the lists in section I so as to select the publication
which supplies the information needed.
